ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, place the right-angle vertex of a triangular ruler, which includes a $30^\circ$ angle, against one side of a straightedge. If $\angle 1 = 37^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle 2$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
Since $\angle 1=37^\circ$, the triangle is a right-angled triangle.\\
Therefore, $\angle 3=90^\circ-\angle 1=53^\circ$.\\
Since the two lines on the ruler are parallel,\\
Therefore, $\angle 4=\angle 3=53^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $\angle 2=180^\circ-\angle 4=\boxed{127^\circ}$.
